metadata.description: AI video generation and editing for Claude, via the Clipwave MCP server.

plugins.name: clipwave
plugins.description: Generate video and images, then cut them together on a real multi-track timeline — Claude drives the whole edit and exports an MP4.

plugins.name: logo-maker
plugins.description: AI logo generator and brand designer: describe your brand and get up to four logo concepts (PNG) in an interactive panel, then refine them in your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: clipwave-video-image-maker
plugins.description: AI video generator and AI image generator: turn a text prompt into images and videos (text to image, text to video), choose model, ratio, resolution and duration in a panel, and render in your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: ugc-video-ads
plugins.description: AI UGC video ad maker: turn a product brief into a short UGC-style video ad for TikTok, Reels and Shorts with an AI presenter and voice, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: cinematic-video
plugins.description: Cinematic AI video maker: describe a scene, pick one of 61 named camera moves (dolly, crane, orbit, crash zoom, dolly zoom, FPV drone, bullet time) plus shot, lighting and look, and render a cinematic text-to-video shot with Veo, Kling, Seedance or Wan in your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: ai-avatar-presenter
plugins.description: AI avatar presenter video maker: turn a topic into an explainer, lesson or self-introduction spoken to camera by an AI presenter with an AI voice, scripted scene by scene and delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: anime-story-video
plugins.description: Anime story video maker: turn a story idea into an animated short in anime, cel, chibi, cartoon, storybook or 3D style, with recurring characters, dialogue and narration, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: horror-story-video
plugins.description: Horror story video maker: turn a scary story idea into a narrated horror, paranormal, creepypasta or suspense short for faceless YouTube, TikTok and Shorts channels, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: travel-video
plugins.description: Travel video maker: turn a destination or a journey into a narrated travel guide, journey diary or short documentary with generated scenes of the place, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: birthday-video
plugins.description: Birthday video maker: turn the memories you describe into a personal birthday, anniversary or milestone tribute video with voice-over and a closing wish spoken to camera, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: short-film-maker
plugins.description: Short film maker: turn a logline into a narrative AI short film with characters, dialogue and a film look across several scenes, in drama, sci-fi, thriller, romance, mystery or fantasy, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: comedy-skit-video
plugins.description: Comedy skit video maker: turn a premise into a short AI comedy skit with original characters, deadpan, absurd, parody, observational or slapstick, built to land one joke for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: fitness-video
plugins.description: Fitness video maker: turn an exercise, routine or training goal into a workout short with an AI athlete training in a gym, outdoors or at home and a short narration, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: ai-video-editor
plugins.description: AI video editor: generate shots and images, then cut them on a real multi-track timeline with trims, transitions and burned-in captions, and export an MP4, all driven by Claude in your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: church-event-video
plugins.description: Church and faith event video maker: turn the details of a service, holiday celebration, conference, retreat or community gathering into a warm invitation video with a welcome spoken to camera, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: ai-voiceover-narrator
plugins.description: AI voiceover and text to speech: turn your own script, article, lesson or story into a narrated MP3, paced for listening in the delivery style you describe and read by a stock AI voice, from your ManyMotions account. No voice cloning.

plugins.name: moodboard-generator
plugins.description: AI moodboard generator: turn a creative brief for a brand, interior, fashion line, event or project into five distinct visual directions, each rendered by two image models, as square images from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: animated-explainer-video
plugins.description: Animated explainer video maker: turn a topic into an explainer of about 30 seconds with four illustrated, animated scenes and a voiceover, no presenter on camera, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: pitch-deck-generator
plugins.description: Pitch deck visual generator: turn your startup's description, problem, market and business model into six slide visuals (problem, solution, market, product, business model, the ask) designed as one deck, as images from your ManyMotions account.
